title: Geo‑Lock Evidence Writer for Dedicated Capacity (Locale Assertions & Retention Playbook)
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: build a lightweight, auditable Geo‑Lock Evidence Writer service that assembles and signs per‑tenant evidence bundles proving physical locality and network isolation for Dedicated capacity. These bundles must be ingestible by auditors and programmatically exportable to S3/Drive, and retained according to customer retention settings.

Scope: 
- Scheduled collection of node-level signals (region tag, hypervisor instance metadata, host-zone, cloud provider zone).
- Active network assertions (egress IP stamp, BGP route snapshot where available).
- Storage/control-plane anchors (dedicated pool ID, VPC identifiers, subnet/CIDR snapshot).
- Signing and notarization: sign bundles using customer‑scoped KMS keys when provided, otherwise platform KMS with audit metadata. Integrate optional Sigstore-based provenance if requested.

Non-goals: long-term on‑prem sensor agents (we rely on existing telemetry); per-request proof issuance (this is periodic evidence generation).
acceptance_criteria: Service produces a signed evidence bundle for each dedicated pool on a configurable cadence (default daily)
Bundles include node metadata, network egress snapshot, deployment manifest, and a manifest of collected hashes
Signed bundles can be pushed to customer S3 or Redwood archival bucket and are downloadable via the Console export flow
Retention settings respected: bundles older than the tenant retention policy are purged or moved to cold storage according to policy
KMS key selection honors customer-supplied key when present and records key fingerprint in the bundle metadata
Audit log entries created for each bundle generation, download, and purge with trace IDs and operator identity
tasks: Design: finalize evidence schema and minimum fields (Aisha)
Security: threat model for signing keys and bundle distribution (security)
Implementation: collector service and signer component (Marco)
Integration: upload hook to S3/gdrive and Console export endpoint (Platform UI)
Retention: implement retention engine and cold storage lifecycle rules (Storage team)
Docs: runbook + auditor guide and sample bundle (DX)
E2E test: synthetic dedicated pool and verification script (QA)

2025-01-22 — Security (Lena Moretti): Reviewed signing plan. Suggested HSM-backed KMS for customer keys and introduced a key-rotation note for bundles signed with platform key. Marked security_review_required = true.
2025-01-28 — Marco Ruiz: MVP produces zipped bundles with sha256 manifest and platform KMS signature. Uploaded sample to staging S3: https://redwood-ci.example/stage/evidence/ENG-221501-sample.zip

2025-02-02 — Aisha Patel: Design review completed. Request for additional network artifacts: BGP snapshots where available and TLS cert serials for exposed endpoints. Added to acceptance criteria. Next: implement retention purge job and Console export button.
